verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a commerce platform, so the axis applies. However, the core of Visa Intelligent Commerce is hosted only. Agent-token provisioning, purchase-intent mandates, credential retrieval and VisaNet authorization controls all run on Visa's credential-gated APIs (api.visaacceptance.com and api.visa.com), with production access arranged by contacting Visa. Only peripheral pieces can run on your own infrastructure: the open Trusted Agent Protocol reference implementation and the npm MCP toolkit client. Neither is a self-hosted deployment of the core product, and the evidence pack shows no such option.
